F2-L02.intro: Ask a name accurately — مَا اسْمُكَ؟ to a boy, مَا اسْمُكِ؟ to a girl — answer with اِسْمِي …, say تَشَرَّفْنَا, and introduce friends with هٰذَا … اِسْمُهُ / هٰذِهِ … اِسْمُهَا.

tasks.task: ASK the teacher his name (he then answers).
tasks.en: And you, Sir, what is your name?
This is my friend; his name is Khalid.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected: introduce your friend Maryam.
tasks.en: This is my friend; her name is Maryam.

tasks.task: Welcome her and give your name.
ASK her name — to a girl (she then answers).
tasks.en: And you, what is your name? (to a girl)

tasks.task: Say it is your friend Omar.
tasks.en: That is my friend; his name is Omar.

tasks.task: Answer the unexpected: she is your sister Sara.
tasks.en: This is my sister; her name is Sara.

roleplays.setting: Introducing friends at a family party
roleplays.title: These are my friends

tasks.task: Say they are your friends from school.
tasks.en: These are my friends from school.

tasks.task: Give his name and one more detail.
tasks.en: His name is Khalid, and he is in my class.

tasks.task: Give her name and one more detail.
tasks.en: Her name is Maryam, and she is Khalid’s sister.

tasks.task: ASK your cousin if he would like to meet them (he then answers).
tasks.en: Would you like to meet them?

tasks.help: لَا، «…» اسْمٌ لِلْوَلَدِ، وَ«…» اسْمٌ لِلْبِنْتِ
tasks.model: لَا، «خَالِدٌ» اسْمٌ لِلْوَلَدِ، وَ«خَالِدَةُ» اسْمٌ لِلْبِنْتِ.
tasks.en: No, “Khalid” is a boy’s name, and “Khalida” is a girl’s name.

conversation.qen: How do you ask a girl her name?
conversation.en: What is your name? (to a girl)

conversation.qen: What is your name, and your brother’s name?
conversation.en: My name is Adam, and my brother’s name is Yusuf.

conversation.qen: Introduce a male friend and a female friend.
conversation.starter: هٰذَا صَدِيقِي، اِسْمُهُ … وَهٰذِهِ صَدِيقَتِي، اِسْمُهَا …
conversation.model: هٰذَا صَدِيقِي، اِسْمُهُ عُمَرُ. وَهٰذِهِ صَدِيقَتِي، اِسْمُهَا زَيْنَبُ.
conversation.en: This is my friend; his name is Omar. And this is my friend; her name is Zaynab.

conversation.q: سَلِّمْ، وَقُلِ اسْمَكَ، وَاسْأَلْ عَنِ الاِسْمِ.
conversation.qen: Greet, give your name and ask for the other person’s name.
conversation.en: Hello! I am Adam, what is your name?

conversation.qen: What is the difference between “hādhā” and “hādhihi”?
conversation.model: «هٰذَا» لِلْمُذَكَّرِ، مِثْلُ «هٰذَا صَدِيقِي»، وَ«هٰذِهِ» لِلْمُؤَنَّثِ، مِثْلُ «هٰذِهِ صَدِيقَتِي».
conversation.en: “Hādhā” is masculine, like “this is my (male) friend”, and “hādhihi” is feminine, like “this is my (female) friend”.

conversation.qen: Do you like your name? Why?
conversation.model: اِسْمِي آدَمُ، وَهُوَ اسْمُ أَوَّلِ إِنْسَانٍ، وَأَنَا أُحِبُّهُ لِأَنَّهُ قَصِيرٌ وَجَمِيلٌ.
conversation.en: My name is Adam, the name of the first human, and I like it because it is short and beautiful.

conversation.qen: Introduce three people from your family.
conversation.model: هٰذَا أَبِي، اِسْمُهُ مُحَمَّدٌ. هٰذِهِ أُمِّي، اِسْمُهَا عَائِشَةُ. وَهٰذَا أَخِي الصَّغِيرُ، اِسْمُهُ يُوسُفُ.
conversation.en: This is my father; his name is Muhammad. This is my mother; her name is Aisha. And this is my little brother; his name is Yusuf.

conversation.qen: How do you ask a group their names?
conversation.model: أَقُولُ: مَا أَسْمَاؤُكُمْ؟ وَأَبْدَأُ بِاسْمِي: أَنَا آدَمُ.
conversation.en: I say: What are your names? And I start with mine: I am Adam.

conversation.model: نَقُولُ «تَشَرَّفْنَا» لِأَنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ مُهَذَّبَةٌ تَعْنِي أَنَّنَا سُعَدَاءُ بِلِقَاءِ الشَّخْصِ الجَدِيدِ.
conversation.en: We say “tasharrafnā” because it is a polite word meaning we are happy to meet the new person.
